title: The Hunger Game Debate: On the Emergence of Over-Competition in Multi-Agent Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Introducing a 'Biased Judge' in multi-agent debates that exhibits explicit, identity-based favoritism towards specific agents regardless of their proposal's quality, and measuring its impact on emergent competitive behaviors like sycophancy and aggressiveness.

Administering post-hoc reflection questionnaires to observe how winning or losing a debate influences agents' causal attributions (self-efficacy vs. externalizing failure) and causes positive or negative evaluative biases towards their peers.
